A '''''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier''' was used by [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] several [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|11}}</ref> [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], [[Axe Woves]], [[Koska Reeves]], and [[Din Djarin]] [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|raided]] the [[Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]] to steal weapons and attempt to learn the location of the [[Darksaber]]. Though the cruiser's [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]] attempted to crash the ship into [[Trask]]'s [[ocean]], Kryze and her allies were able to save the ship, which they planned to use to [[Conflict on Mandalore|liberate]] their [[homeworld]] of [[Mandalore]].<ref name="Chapter 11" />
